s.note: Laura's coordinates for Eden in North Dakota
s.how: Braise 800g beef chuck with 3 soaked dried chillies, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 3 hours until it shreds. Serve in 16 warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and lime.

s.note: the corn growing on the Munson farm
s.how: Cut the kernels off 3 corn cobs. Whisk 120g flour, 2 eggs and 125ml milk, then fold in the corn, 2 spring onions and a chopped chilli. Fry spoonfuls until golden and serve with sour cream.

m.note: the one good dinner the Munsons share
m.how: Season 4 pork chops and pan-fry 4 minutes a side. Fry 1 sliced onion and 1 sliced apple in the pan, add 300ml chicken stock and 1 tsp mustard and reduce. Serve with 800g potatoes mashed with butter and 300g steamed green beans.

w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 100g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp cornflour. Line a dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

d.n: Logan's limo bourbon and maple sour
d.note: driving a hire limo to get by
d.how: For each drink, dry shake 60ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 15ml maple syrup and half an egg white for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake hard for 15 seconds. Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass. Add a tiny pinch of smoked salt on the foam and twist orange peel over the top.
